name: Morpheus
install:
set -euo pipefail
export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s "bun-v1.4.0"
  export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
fi
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run typecheck
bun test
